_readme: Scheduled encyclopedia queue. Each run takes the FIRST entry with status 'queued' from each list, builds it, and sets status to 'done' with date and commit. Reorder freely; add entries in the same shape. 'labs' are starting ideas, not specs: improve them if a better mechanism exists. 'prereq' and 'cross' are existing slugs used for graph.js PREREQ and CROSS.

title: Hyperbolic geometry: where parallels multiply
双曲幾何：平行線が増える世界
labs: Poincaré disc: drag two points, draw the geodesic arc, compare hyperbolic and Euclidean distance; readout of distance formula
Triangles: drag vertices, angle sum = π − area (Gauss–Bonnet), live
Tilings {p,q}: choose p,q with 1/p+1/q<1/2, render the tiling, drag to apply a Möbius isometry of the disc

title: Elliptic curves: geometry that adds
楕円曲線：足し算ができる幾何
labs: Chord-and-tangent law: drag P and Q on y²=x³+ax+b, show R and P+Q, sliders a,b, discriminant readout
Curves over F_p: scatter of points mod p, count vs Hasse bound p+1±2√p, step multiples of a generator
Torus picture: lattice ℂ/Λ with the Weierstrass ℘ map, addition on the torus matching addition on the curve

title: Knot theory: telling tangles apart
結び目理論：絡まりを見分ける
labs: Reidemeister moves: animated diagrams of R1, R2, R3 on a live knot diagram
Tricolourability: click arcs to colour a diagram, check validity; trefoil yes, unknot only trivially
Invariants table: crossing number, Kauffman bracket / Jones polynomial computed for chosen small knots, torus knots T(p,q) drawn in 3D

title: Fractal geometry: dimension between the integers
フラクタル幾何：整数の間の次元
labs: Iterated function systems: chaos game with draggable maps, similarity dimension readout from Moran equation
Box counting: log-log plot of N(ε) for Koch, Sierpinski, coastline; slope = dimension
Julia and Mandelbrot: click c in the Mandelbrot set to draw its Julia set, connectedness readout

title: Wavelets: seeing frequency in time
ウェーブレット：時間の中の周波数
labs: Heisenberg boxes: Fourier vs STFT vs wavelet tilings of the time-frequency plane for a chirp
Haar multiresolution: approximate a signal level by level, detail coefficients bar chart
Compression: keep the largest k coefficients, compare Fourier vs wavelet reconstruction error on a signal with a jump

title: Representation theory: groups acting as matrices
表現論：行列として作用する群
labs: Symmetries of a triangle as 2×2 matrices; pick a group element, watch it act, character = trace readout
Character table of S3/D4 with orthogonality checked live; decompose a chosen representation
Vibrations of a symmetric molecule/ring: normal modes grouped by irreducible representation

title: Galois theory: symmetries of roots
ガロア理論：根の対称性
labs: Roots in the complex plane: drag coefficients, braid the roots around each other, see the permutation produced (monodromy)
Field tower and subgroup lattice side by side for x⁴−2 or x³−2, click to highlight the correspondence
Constructibility: which regular n-gons are constructible (Gauss–Wantzel), animated construction for n=5, 17 check

title: Combinatorics: counting with generating functions
組合せ論：母関数で数える
labs: Integer partitions: Young diagrams, Euler's distinct = odd theorem with a live bijection
Catalan objects: paths, trees, triangulations in lockstep for chosen n
Generating function asymptotics: coefficients vs singularity analysis prediction on a log plot

title: Game theory: equilibria and strategy
ゲーム理論：均衡と戦略
labs: 2×2 games: edit payoffs, best-response lines, mixed Nash equilibrium located
Replicator dynamics on the simplex for rock-paper-scissors variants, streamlines and fixed points
Zero-sum games as linear programs: minimax value and the duality with the LP picture

title: Ergodic theory: time averages and space averages
エルゴード理論：時間平均と空間平均
labs: Irrational rotation: orbit on the circle fills uniformly; rational vs irrational; Weyl equidistribution histogram
Baker's map / cat map: mixing of a coloured region, correlation decay readout
Birkhoff averages converging for the doubling map; leading-digit (Benford) as a byproduct

title: Projective geometry: where parallel lines meet
射影幾何：平行線が交わる場所
labs: Perspective drawing: vanishing points and horizon from a camera slider
Cross-ratio invariance: drag a projection, four collinear points keep their cross-ratio
Conics as one object: plane cutting a cone, ellipse/parabola/hyperbola as projective equivalents, Pascal's theorem live

title: Coding theory: correcting errors
符号理論：誤りを訂正する
labs: Hamming(7,4): flip bits by clicking, syndrome locates the error; Venn diagram view
Sphere packing in Hamming space and the Hamming bound; rate vs distance plot with Gilbert–Varshamov
Reed–Solomon as polynomial evaluation: erase points, interpolation recovers the message

title: Random matrices: order from noise
ランダム行列：雑音から生まれる秩序
labs: Wigner semicircle: eigenvalue histogram of GOE matrices converging as n grows
Level repulsion: nearest-neighbour spacings, Wigner surmise vs Poisson
Marchenko–Pastur: sample covariance eigenvalues vs aspect ratio, relevance to PCA noise floor

title: Symmetry and tilings: the 17 wallpaper groups
対称性とタイリング：17 の壁紙群
labs: Draw a motif; choose a wallpaper group; the pattern regenerates with its symmetry elements marked
Crystallographic restriction: why only 1,2,3,4,6-fold rotations tile; trace of rotation must be an integer
Penrose tiling: aperiodic order, substitution steps, fivefold diffraction pattern

title: Convex geometry: shapes, hulls, and duality
凸幾何：形・凸包・双対性
labs: Convex hull: drag points, Graham scan animation, Carathéodory witness
Polar duality: shape and its polar body side by side; support function plot
Concentration in high dimension: volume of the ball near its equator/shell as n grows

title: Riemann surfaces: making functions single-valued
リーマン面：関数を一価にする
labs: √z and log z: walk around the branch point, sheets swap, 3D surface view
Branch cuts and monodromy for w²=(z−a)(z−b)(z−c)(z−d): genus readout via Riemann–Hurwitz
Uniformisation: sphere, plane, disc as the three universal covers with example surfaces

title: Approximation theory: how well polynomials fit
近似理論：多項式はどこまで合うか
labs: Best uniform approximation: Remez equioscillation for a chosen f and degree
Bernstein polynomials and Weierstrass: converge slowly but surely
Smoothness vs convergence rate: Chebyshev coefficient decay for analytic, C^k and kinked functions

title: Computational complexity: easy, hard, and in between
計算量理論：易しい・難しい・その間
labs: Growth rates: n, n log n, n², 2ⁿ, n! race with a time budget slider
SAT phase transition: random 3-SAT satisfiability probability vs clause ratio near 4.27
Reductions: 3-colouring ↔ SAT encoding shown on a small graph, click to verify a certificate in polynomial time

title: Tensors: objects that transform correctly
テンソル：正しく変換される量
labs: Covariant vs contravariant components under a skewed basis, drag the basis
Stress tensor: rotate a small square, traction vectors, Mohr's circle
Metric tensor and index gymnastics on polar coordinates; Christoffel symbols from the metric

title: Spectral graph theory: hearing the shape of a network
スペクトルグラフ理論：ネットワークの形を聴く
labs: Laplacian eigenvectors as vibration modes of a graph, drawn as node colours
Fiedler vector and spectral clustering: cut a two-community graph
Cheeger inequality: conductance vs λ₂ on families of graphs

title: Rigid-body dynamics: spinning, tumbling, precessing
剛体力学：回転・転倒・歳差
labs: Tennis-racket (Dzhanibekov) effect: Euler's equations, stable vs unstable axes, 3D body plus angular-momentum sphere with polhodes
Gyroscope: precession rate vs spin, nutation when released
Inertia tensor: drag masses, principal axes and the inertia ellipsoid update

title: Atomic physics: orbitals and spectra
原子物理：軌道とスペクトル
labs: Hydrogen orbitals: |ψ_nlm|² cross-sections and radial probability for chosen n,l,m
Spectral series: energy level diagram, click transitions to get Lyman/Balmer lines on a rendered spectrum
Zeeman splitting: B-field slider splits lines, selection rules Δm=0,±1 shown

title: Quantum information: entanglement and its limits
量子情報：もつれとその限界
labs: Bell/CHSH: choose measurement angles, correlation curve vs classical bound 2, max 2√2
Teleportation circuit step by step on the Bloch sphere
Entanglement entropy of a two-qubit state as it moves from product to Bell state; Schmidt coefficients

title: Cosmology: the expanding universe
宇宙論：膨張する宇宙
labs: Friedmann equation: scale factor a(t) for chosen Ω_m, Ω_Λ, Ω_k; age of the universe readout
Distances: comoving, luminosity, angular-diameter distance vs redshift
Horizons and light cones in comoving coordinates (conformal diagram)

title: Laser physics: gain, cavities, and coherence
レーザー物理：利得・共振器・コヒーレンス
labs: Rate equations: pump rate vs photon number, threshold as a transcritical bifurcation
Fabry–Pérot cavity: longitudinal modes, gain curve, which modes lase
Gaussian beam: waist, Rayleigh range, focusing through a lens

title: Semiconductor physics: bands, doping, junctions
半導体物理：バンド・ドーピング・接合
labs: Fermi–Dirac occupation and carrier density vs temperature and doping; Fermi level moves
p–n junction: band bending, depletion width vs bias, built-in potential
Diode I–V curve (Shockley) with temperature; LED/photodiode quadrant

title: Acoustics: sound, resonance, and hearing
音響学：音・共鳴・聴覚
labs: Standing waves in pipes and strings; violin string harmonics and bowing position
Chladni patterns: modes of a square plate, sand gathering on nodal lines
Doppler effect and shock cone (Mach) from a moving source

title: Nuclear physics: binding, decay, and fission
原子核物理：結合・崩壊・核分裂
labs: Binding energy per nucleon: semi-empirical mass formula terms, stacked contributions vs A
Decay chains: Bateman equations, secular equilibrium, parent/daughter curves
Tunnelling alpha decay: Gamow factor, Geiger–Nuttall law log plot

title: Continuum mechanics: stress, strain, and elasticity
連続体力学：応力・ひずみ・弾性
labs: Deformation gradient: drag a grid, strain ellipse and principal strains
Beam bending: Euler–Bernoulli deflection under point/distributed load, stress colour map
Buckling: Euler critical load, post-buckled shapes

title: Gravitational waves: ripples in spacetime
重力波：時空のさざ波
labs: Plus and cross polarisations deforming a ring of test masses
Binary inspiral chirp: frequency and amplitude vs time from chirp mass (leading order)
Michelson interferometer response vs arrival direction (antenna pattern)

title: Stellar astrophysics: how stars shine and die
恒星天体物理：星の輝きと死
labs: Hertzsprung–Russell diagram: main sequence, mass–luminosity, lifetime readout
Hydrostatic equilibrium: polytrope (Lane–Emden) density profiles
Degeneracy pressure and the Chandrasekhar limit: mass–radius relation of white dwarfs

title: Superconductivity: zero resistance and flux expulsion
超伝導：ゼロ抵抗と磁束の排除
labs: Meissner effect: London penetration depth, field profile at the surface
Ginzburg–Landau free energy: order parameter vs temperature, second-order transition
Flux quantisation and vortex lattice in a type II superconductor

title: Particle physics: the Standard Model at a glance
素粒子物理：標準模型の概観
labs: Relativistic kinematics: invariant mass of a two-particle decay, resonance peak
Quark model: SU(3) weight diagrams for mesons/baryons, click to build hadrons
Running couplings: α_s and α vs energy scale (one-loop)

title: Neuron biophysics: how a spike happens
神経生物物理：スパイクの仕組み
labs: Nernst and GHK: ion concentrations to reversal potentials and resting potential
Hodgkin–Huxley: action potential with m,h,n gating traces, threshold and refractoriness
Cable equation: passive decay along a dendrite vs length constant; myelination and conduction speed

title: Radiation: how charges broadcast
放射：電荷はどう電波を出すか
labs: Accelerated charge: kinked field lines (Purcell picture) animated
Dipole radiation pattern and Larmor power; half-wave antenna
Phased arrays: steer a beam by phase offsets, array factor polar plot

title: Scattering: learning structure by throwing things
散乱理論：ぶつけて構造を知る
labs: Rutherford scattering: trajectories vs impact parameter, cross-section histogram vs 1/sin⁴(θ/2)
Partial waves: phase shifts and resonance in s-wave scattering
Born approximation: form factor as a Fourier transform of the potential

title: Magnetism and the Ising model
磁性とイジング模型
labs: Metropolis Ising lattice: temperature slider across T_c, domains form
Mean-field self-consistency: m = tanh(βJzm) graphical solution, spontaneous symmetry breaking
Hysteresis loop of a ferromagnet vs temperature

title: Nonlinear waves: solitons and shocks
非線形波：ソリトンと衝撃波
labs: KdV two-soliton collision: pass through each other with a phase shift
Burgers equation: characteristics crossing and shock formation time
Traffic flow: density waves and phantom jams (LWR model)

title: Geophysical fluids: rotation and the weather
地球流体：回転と天気
labs: Coriolis deflection on a rotating turntable, inertial circles
Geostrophic balance: pressure map with winds along isobars
Lorenz system as convection: butterfly attractor and sensitivity

title: Many-body quantum physics: bosons, fermions, and condensates
量子多体系：ボース粒子・フェルミ粒子・凝縮
labs: Bose–Einstein vs Fermi–Dirac vs Boltzmann occupation with temperature
Bose–Einstein condensation: condensate fraction below T_c in a harmonic trap
Exchange symmetry: two-particle wavefunctions symmetric/antisymmetric, Pauli hole and bunching
